title: The Insane Story Behind the McLaren F1
description:
In nineteen eighty-eight, four men sat at an airport in Italy, and one of them started sketching a car. McLaren had never built a road car. The sketch showed a three-seater with the driver in the middle. Four years later, that sketch became the McLaren F one, one of the most famous cars ever made. This is the insane story behind it, and it starts with a boy from South Africa. Here is the twist. The man who designed the F one had already shocked the racing world once, with a Formula One car that won its only race and was then withdrawn. And decades later, he would list everything he disliked about the F one, and build a new car to fix it.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
